name: Survey
description: Core survey entity with metadata and configuration

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the survey

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title or name of the survey

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the survey purpose

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the survey (draft, active, closed)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the survey was created

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the survey expires or closes

fields.name: isAnonymous
fields.description: Whether responses are collected anonymously

name: SurveyTemplate
description: Reusable survey templates for quick survey creation

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the survey template

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the survey template

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of the template's purpose and content

fields.name: category
fields.description: Category or type of survey (e.g., Customer Satisfaction, Employee Feedback)

fields.name: questions
fields.description: Array of predefined questions and their configuration

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the template is currently available for use

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the template was created

fields.name: usageCount
fields.description: Number of times this template has been used to create surveys

relationships.description: Surveys created from this template

name: Question
description: Survey question entity with text, type, and configuration

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the question

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the parent survey or template

fields.name: text
fields.description: The question text displayed to respondents

fields.name: type
fields.description: Question type (e.g., multiple-choice, text, rating, yes-no)

fields.name: order
fields.description: Display order within the survey

fields.name: required
fields.description: Whether the question must be answered

fields.name: config
fields.description: Additional configuration options (choices, validation rules, etc.)

name: QuestionType
description: Types of questions available (multiple choice, text, rating, etc.)

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the question type

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the question type (e.g., Multiple Choice, Text Input)

fields.name: code
fields.description: Unique code identifier (e.g., MULTIPLE_CHOICE, TEXT, RATING)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the question type and its use case

fields.name: allowsMultipleAnswers
fields.description: Whether this question type supports multiple answer selections

fields.name: requiresOptions
fields.description: Whether this question type requires predefined answer options

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this question type is currently available for use

name: Response
description: Survey response submission record

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the response

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the survey being responded to

fields.name: respondentId
fields.description: Identifier of the person submitting the response

fields.name: answers
fields.description: Collection of question-answer pairs

fields.name: submittedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the response was submitted

fields.name: status
fields.description: Response status (draft, submitted, completed)

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address of the respondent for tracking purposes

name: RespondentInfo
description: Information about survey respondent

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the respondent

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the survey being responded to

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address of the respondent

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full name of the respondent

fields.name: startedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when respondent started the survey

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when respondent completed the survey

fields.name: isAnonymous
fields.description: Whether the response is anonymous

name: SurveyDistribution
description: Tracks survey distribution channels, recipients, and delivery status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the distribution record

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the survey being distributed

fields.name: distributionChannel
fields.description: Channel used for distribution (email, sms, link, qr_code, etc.)

fields.name: recipientIdentifier
fields.description: Email address, phone number, or other recipient identifier

fields.name: status
fields.description: Distribution status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, opened, completed)

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the survey was sent

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Expiration date for the survey link

fields.name: responseId
fields.description: Reference to the response if completed

name: ResponseSession
description: Tracks in-progress survey sessions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the response session

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the survey being responded to

fields.name: respondentInfoId
fields.description: Reference to the respondent information

fields.name: sessionToken
fields.description: Unique token for resuming the session

fields.name: currentQuestionId
fields.description: ID of the current question being answered

fields.name: startedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the session was started

fields.name: lastActivityAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the last activity in this session

fields.name: isCompleted
fields.description: Whether the session has been completed

constraints.uniqueSessionToken: sessionToken must be unique across all sessions

name: AnalyticsData
description: Aggregated analytics data for survey responses

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for analytics record

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the survey being analyzed

fields.name: questionId
fields.description: Reference to specific question (null for survey-level metrics)

fields.name: metricType
fields.description: Type of metric (e.g., response_count, completion_rate, average_score, sentiment)

fields.name: metricValue
fields.description: Calculated metric value

fields.name: aggregationPeriod
fields.description: Time period for aggregation (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, all_time)

fields.name: calculatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when analytics were calculated

relationships.description: Analytics belong to a survey
Analytics may be for a specific question

constraints.metricType: Must be a valid metric type identifier
constraints.aggregationPeriod: Must be one of: daily, weekly, monthly, all_time

name: ExportConfiguration
description: Configuration settings for data exports

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the export configuration

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the survey being exported

fields.name: exportFormat
fields.description: Format of the export (CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF)

fields.name: includeFields
fields.description: List of field names to include in the export

fields.name: dateRange
fields.description: Start and end dates for filtering exported data

fields.name: createdBy
fields.description: User ID who created this export configuration

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was created

relationships.description: Links export configuration to a specific survey

name: User
description: User account information and profile data

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role (e.g., admin, manager, analyst, viewer)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

name: Role
description: User role definitions for access control

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the role

fields.name: name
fields.description: Role name (e.g., Admin, Manager, Viewer)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the role and its purpose

fields.name: permissions
fields.description: List of permission strings assigned to this role

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the role is currently active and can be assigned

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the role was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated

relationships.description: Users assigned to this role

validation.name: Must be alphanumeric with spaces and underscores only
validation.permissions: Must be a non-empty array for active roles

name: Permission
description: Granular permissions for system features and actions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the permission

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unique name of the permission (e.g., 'survey.create', 'response.view')

fields.name: resource
fields.description: Resource or entity the permission applies to (e.g., 'survey', 'user', 'analytics')

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action allowed by this permission (e.g., 'create', 'read', 'update', 'delete', 'export')

fields.name: description
fields.description: Human-readable description of what this permission grants

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this permission is currently active and can be assigned

relationships.description: Roles that have this permission

constraints.uniquePermissionName: Permission name must be unique across the system
constraints.validAction: Action must be one of: create, read, update, delete, export, manage

name: SurveySettings
description: Configuration settings for survey behavior and appearance

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for survey settings

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the associated survey

fields.name: allowAnonymous
fields.description: Whether anonymous responses are permitted

fields.name: allowMultipleResponses
fields.description: Whether respondents can submit multiple times

fields.name: showProgressBar
fields.description: Display progress indicator to respondents

fields.name: randomizeQuestions
fields.description: Randomize question order for each respondent

fields.name: theme
fields.description: Visual theme or color scheme for survey display

fields.name: completionMessage
fields.description: Custom message displayed upon survey completion
fields.defaultValue: Thank you for completing this survey!

relationships.description: Each settings configuration belongs to one survey

constraints.uniqueSurveySettings: Each survey should have only one settings configuration

name: SurveyVersion
description: Version history for survey changes and revisions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the survey version

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the parent survey

fields.name: versionNumber
fields.description: Sequential version number for the survey

fields.name: changeDescription
fields.description: Description of changes made in this version

fields.name: snapshotData
fields.description: Complete snapshot of survey configuration at this version

fields.name: createdBy
fields.description: User ID who created this version

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when this version was created

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this is the currently active version

relationships.description: Each version belongs to one survey
Each version is created by one user

constraints.uniqueActiveVersion: Only one version per survey can have isActive=true

name: ValidationRule
description: Validation rules for question responses

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the validation rule

fields.name: questionId
fields.description: Reference to the question this rule applies to

fields.name: ruleType
fields.description: Type of validation (e.g., required, minLength, maxLength, pattern, range, email)

fields.name: ruleValue
fields.description: Value or parameter for the validation rule (e.g., regex pattern, min/max value)

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: Custom error message to display when validation fails

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this validation rule is currently active

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Order in which validation rules are executed (lower numbers first)

relationships.description: Each validation rule belongs to one question

constraints.ruleType: Must be one of: required, minLength, maxLength, pattern, range, email, url, numeric, date, custom

name: QuestionOption
description: Options for multiple choice, dropdown, and checkbox questions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the question option

fields.name: questionId
fields.description: Reference to the parent question

fields.name: text
fields.description: Display text for the option

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value stored when this option is selected

fields.name: displayOrder
fields.description: Order in which the option appears in the list

fields.name: isOther
fields.description: Indicates if this is an 'Other' option with text input

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the option is currently active and selectable

relationships.description: Each option belongs to one question

constraints.uniqueValuePerQuestion: Combination of questionId and value should be unique

name: Answer
description: Individual answer to a survey question

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the answer

fields.name: responseId
fields.description: Reference to the parent response

fields.name: questionId
fields.description: Reference to the question being answered

fields.name: value
fields.description: The actual answer value (text, number, or serialized data)

fields.name: selectedOptionIds
fields.description: Array of selected option IDs for multiple choice questions

fields.name: answeredAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the answer was provided

relationships.description: Answer belongs to a response
Answer corresponds to a question

constraints.uniqueAnswerPerQuestion: Each question can only be answered once per response

name: Report
description: Generated report configurations and metadata

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the report

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the survey this report is generated for

fields.name: reportType
fields.description: Type of report (summary, detailed, analytics, export)

fields.name: configuration
fields.description: Report configuration settings including filters, date ranges, and display options

fields.name: generatedBy
fields.description: User ID who generated the report

fields.name: generatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the report was generated

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of report generation (pending, completed, failed)

fields.name: fileUrl
fields.description: URL or path to the generated report file

name: Metrics
description: Calculated metrics and KPIs for surveys

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the metric

fields.name: surveyId
fields.description: Reference to the survey this metric belongs to

fields.name: metricType
fields.description: Type of metric (e.g., response_rate, completion_rate, avg_time, nps_score)

fields.name: value
fields.description: Calculated metric value

fields.name: calculatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the metric was calculated

fields.name: periodStart
fields.description: Start date of the period this metric covers

fields.name: periodEnd
fields.description: End date of the period this metric covers

relationships.description: Each metric belongs to one survey

constraints.metricType: Must be a valid metric type identifier
constraints.value: Must be a numeric value representing the calculated metric

name: ExportFile
description: Generated export file records tracking survey data exports

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the export file

fields.name: configurationId
fields.description: Reference to the export configuration used

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Name of the generated export file

fields.name: fileUrl
fields.description: Storage URL or path to the export file

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the export file in bytes

fields.name: status
fields.description: Export status (pending, completed, failed)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the export was initiated

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the export file will be deleted

name: ExportSchedule
description: Scheduled automatic exports for survey data and reports

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the export schedule

fields.name: exportConfigurationId
fields.description: Reference to the export configuration to use

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Schedule frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, custom)

fields.name: cronExpression
fields.description: Cron expression for custom scheduling

fields.name: nextRunDate
fields.description: Next scheduled execution date and time

fields.name: lastRunDate
fields.description: Last execution date and time

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the schedule is currently active

fields.name: createdBy
fields.description: User ID who created the schedule

name: Visualization
description: Data visualization configurations and settings for survey analytics and reports

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the visualization

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the visualization

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of visualization (bar, pie, line, table, heatmap, etc.)

fields.name: reportId
fields.description: Reference to the associated report

fields.name: configuration
fields.description: JSON object containing chart settings, colors, axes, filters, and display options

fields.name: dataSource
fields.description: Reference to the data source (questionId, metricId, or analyticsDataId)

fields.name: displayOrder
fields.description: Order in which visualization appears in the report

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the visualization is currently active and visible

relationships.description: Visualization belongs to a report
Visualization may reference a specific question

name: Dashboard
description: Custom dashboard configurations for analytics

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the dashboard

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the dashboard

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user who owns this dashboard

fields.name: configuration
fields.description: Dashboard layout and widget configuration settings

fields.name: isDefault
fields.description: Whether this is the default dashboard for the user

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the dashboard was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the dashboard was last updated

relationships.description: Dashboard belongs to a user

constraints.uniqueDefaultPerUser: Only one default dashboard per user

name: UserRole
description: Association between users and their assigned roles

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user-role association

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user being assigned a role

fields.name: roleId
fields.description: Reference to the role being assigned to the user

fields.name: assignedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the role was assigned to the user

fields.name: assignedBy
fields.description: Reference to the user who assigned this role

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Optional expiration date for temporary role assignments

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the role assignment is currently active

relationships.description: The user who has this role
The role assigned to the user
The user who performed the role assignment

indexes.description: Ensures a user cannot have the same role assigned multiple times
Optimizes queries for finding all roles of a user
Optimizes queries for finding all users with a specific role
Optimizes queries for active role assignments

constraints.uniqueUserRole: A user can only have one active assignment of the same role
constraints.validExpiration: If expiresAt is set, it must be in the future relative to assignedAt

name: RolePermission
description: Association between roles and their permissions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the role-permission association

fields.name: roleId
fields.description: Reference to the role being granted permissions

fields.name: permissionId
fields.description: Reference to the permission being assigned

fields.name: grantedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the permission was granted to the role

fields.name: grantedBy
fields.description: User ID who granted this permission to the role

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this permission assignment is currently active

relationships.description: The role that has this permission
The permission assigned to the role
The user who granted this permission

indexes.description: Ensures a permission can only be assigned once to a role
Optimizes queries for all permissions of a role
Optimizes queries for all roles with a specific permission

constraints.uniqueRolePermission: A role cannot have the same permission assigned multiple times
